title: Recorded Work-Cell Update
statement: Let $a$ be an action for a Boolean multi-tape machine, let $c$ be a configuration, and let $i$ be a work-tape index and $z$ an integer cell position. The recorded cell whose content is that of tape $i$ at $z$ and whose mark indicates whether the head is at $z$ is transformed by the action's write instruction for tape $i$ into a cell whose content is exactly the content of tape $i$ at $z$ after applying $a$ to $c$, while the mark remains unchanged.
